reference.sampleType: Historical self-selected online response records; not population-representative
reference.uniqueness: N counts response records, not guaranteed unique individuals

source.attribution: Derived from Kajonius, P. J. & Johnson, J. A. (2019), Supplementary materials, PsychArchives. Filters and percentile calculations by Fem; no endorsement implied.

scoring.liveAnswers: Reverse only minus-keyed raw responses once: 6-answer. Then sum.
scoring.input: Integer keyed sum: 24..120 per domain, 4..20 per facet. Never use the old 0..100 position.
scoring.ties: Midrank; half of the tied records contribute to rank.
scoring.rounding: Display nearest integer with floor(percentile+0.5); retain unrounded counts for calculation.
scoring.endpoints: Valid empirical midranks can round to 0 or 100. Do not clamp without explicitly documenting a display-only rule.

applicability.noteNo: Sammenlignet med amerikanske nettdeltakere. Sammenligningen bygger på den engelske testen; overføring til norsk språk er ikke særskilt validert.
applicability.noteEn: Compared with US online respondents who took the English test. This historical volunteer sample is not representative of the entire US population.
